recent.text: NEW: Rockets wasted little time exposing the Pacers' defensive flaws Wednesday. They repeatedly got to the basket or found open looks from deep, making 19 3s in a 119-104 win. Plus, Carlisle's ejection, officiating, Zubac's minutes and Smith's injury: https://t.co/k1plWOQZeN

recent.text: Andrew Nembhard, Braden Smith both listed as questionable for Friday. Nembhard with a left hip sprain, Smith with a right ankle sprain.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak

recent.text: Pacers listing Braden Smith as questionable for Friday's NBA Cup game in Cleveland - right ankle sprain. That's encouraging after what we saw last night. Nembhard is also questionable, and McConnell is probable.
recent.author: Scott Agness

recent.text: Pacers haven't put out their injury report yet, so no news on Andrew Nembhard or Braden Smith. Cavs will be missing Evan Mobley, Nae'Qwan Tomlin and Jaylon Tyson. Peyton Watson is questionable with a low back contusion.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak

recent.text: Aaron Nesmith is having to guard Kevin Durant and run around screens from Steven Adams. That seems like fun.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak

recent.text: So Steven Adams crushed Nesmith on a screen and Braden Smith did in fact take out Steven Adams. You do gotta hand it to the man.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak

recent.text: So Steven Adams just got knocked down and Braden Smith might have had something to do with it. Adams gets up and walks towards Smith. Nesmith pushes him back. Smith holds his ground. Everybody gets separated. They're going to watch this on video.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak
